 Print Actor Nandish Sandhu has begun a new chapter in his personal life. He married actress Kavita Banerjee in a traditional Bengali wedding ceremony in Kolkata on Saturday, November 14. The couple, who got engaged in 2025, exchanged wedding vows in the presence of their close friends and family members. The wedding celebrations were spread across two days starting on November 13. The celebrations included an engagement ceremony, sangeet and haldi. Kavita embraced traditional Bengali bridal fashion for the occasion, choosing a red and cream Banarasi silk saree. Nandish complemented her look in a cream silk dhoti and kurta. Watch Nandish Sandhu Announces Engagement With Kavita Banerjee; Shares Sweet Pics A video from the ceremony also captured a special moment from the Bengali wedding rituals. Kavita was seen performing Saat Paak, also known as Saat Paake Ghora, in which the bride circles the groom seven times. Nandish appeared cheerful as his bride performed the traditional ritual. Nandish, born on December 25, 1981, in Dholpur, Rajasthan, is 44 years old. Kavita, who was born on July 12, 1992, is 34. The couple has an age gap of 10 years. Their wedding marks Nandish’s second marriage. Join conversation

 Before finding love with Kavita, the actor was married to television actress Rashami Desai . The two first crossed paths on the sets of the popular television show Uttaran, where they played an on-screen couple. Their professional association eventually developed into a relationship off screen, and they tied the knot on February 12, 2012, in Dholpur, Rajasthan. However, their marriage faced difficulties, and the couple announced their separation in 2014. After two years of marriage, they decided to part ways, with their divorce being legally finalised in 2016.
